title: Do we all visit the same mall?

classification.question_topic: Whether everyone who visits 'mall world' in sleep visits the same place and how connected those experiences are.
classification.skip_reason: No dream narrative or concrete phenomenological description of locations/events; post is a question/theory about shared vs individual Mall World.
